title.value: T2VIndexer: A Generative Video Indexer for Efficient Text-Video Retrieval
title.justification: The title of the paper is mentioned explicitly at the top.
title.quote: T2VIndexer: A Generative Video Indexer for Efficient Text-Video Retrieval

analysis.description: This paper introduces T2VIndexer, a generative model used for text-video retrieval by directly generating video identifiers for efficient retrieval without a complete search of the entire database. The method focuses on enhancing retrieval efficiency while maintaining high accuracy, using hierarchical structures and semantic-aware mechanisms to augment retrieval processes.

type.justification: The paper provides experiments and empirical results on datasets like MSR-VTT, MSVD, ActivityNet, and DiDeMo to demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed model, T2VIndexer.
type.quote: Our method consistently enhances the retrieval efficiency of current state-of-the-art models on four standard datasets.

name.justification: The paper's focus is on efficient video retrieval methods, specifically utilizing a generative model for text-video retrieval.
name.quote: Given a query text description, text-video retrieval aims to retrieve videos that are semantically relevant to the query.

name.justification: The proposed method includes a generative model for the task of generating video identifiers.
name.quote: we introduce a model-based video indexer named T2VIndexer, which is a sequence-to-sequence generative model directly generating video identifiers

name.justification: The research utilizes multi-modal data inputs, primarily text and video, to improve retrieval efficiency and effectiveness.
name.quote: Generative models are common in natural language processing and computer vision, and have been successfully applied in document retrieval, but their application in multimodal retrieval remains unexplored.

name.justification: The paper introduces and extensively discusses T2VIndexer as the proposed solution for efficient video retrieval.
name.quote: we propose a sequence-to-sequence generative network that supports Text query to Video candidate Index, named as T2VIndexer.

is_contributed.justification: The model is a novel contribution of the paper itself.
is_contributed.quote: we introduce a model-based video indexer named T2VIndexer

is_executed.justification: The paper describes empirical results which imply execution of the model.
is_executed.quote: T2VIndexer significantly reduces inference time while maintaining the baseline effect.

is_compared.justification: T2VIndexer is compared against other methods in terms of retrieval efficiency and accuracy.
is_compared.quote: T2VIndexer reduces the time cost by 50%. The efficiency improvement increases gradually with the size of the candidate set.
